# 00000003153

**English.** Definition: Killing fields and separation of variables: the Lie criterion for separability. Conjecture: The Killing criterion for separation of variables: Hamilton–Jacobi separability is generated by the commuting family of quadratic Killing fields, with the maximal dimension of the family the symmetry order of the space. (Killing separation commuting family maximal dimension)

**中文。** 定义：Killing 场与分离变量：可分离性的李判据。猜想：分离变量的 Killing 判据：Hamilton–Jacobi 可分性由二次型 Killing 场的交换族生成且族的极大维数为空间的对称阶。（Killing 分离交换族极大维）
